column3: With respect to the Colonial Pointe Mortgage Loan (2.3%), based on its current compliance with affordable housing requirements associated with the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (“LIHTC”) program (Section 42 of the Internal Revenue Code), the Mortgaged Property was granted a 100% real estate property tax exemption pursuant to SC Statute 12-37-220(B)(11)(e) in January 2025. The property tax exemption requires that 40% of units be set aside for residents that earn 60% of AMI or less, and 35% of units be set aside for residents that earn 80% of AMI or less. The remaining 25% of units can be rented at market rates. The loan underwriting was based on a 100% exemption from real property taxes. If the property tax exemption is not maintained during the loan term, the loan documents provide that the borrower and guarantors are obligated to pay-down the loan in an amount required to achieve the greater of (A) an 8.0% debt yield or (B) a 1.25x DSCR (IO) based on loan underwriting that includes fully-loaded real property taxes. Further, the loan documents provide that the borrower and guarantors have springing recourse liability for the amount of such pay-down if not timely made.
